Hi Carla,

Attached for the Monarch Health pack: scim-sync-log-2025-12.csv, saml-assertion-samples-2025.txt, and role-ownership-matrix-2026-01.xlsx. Short explanation below to accompany the matrix:

Role ownership & least-privilege rationale (summary):
We maintain an owner-for-role model where every elective role has an assigned human owner tracked in the role registry. Owners are typically the team lead responsible for the primary business function the role supports and are responsible for access reviews and attestation. Temporary JIT delegates (contractors, short-term admins) are modeled as expirable role memberships and flagged in the role registry; they are excluded from long-term owner counts and shown in the matrix under a separate column ("temporary_oncall").

Least-privilege decisions are surfaced via the privilege-impact column in the registry which ties each role to minimal resource sets and documented business justification. Service accounts are segmented into three classes (automation, infra, third-party) and each class has stricter rotation and approval controls; service accounts are listed in the attached matrix with owner, rotation cadence, and mitigating controls.

If you need the UID mapping for traceability we can provide it over an NDA-backed channel; otherwise the provided artifacts should satisfy the auditor's immediate needs.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you want the alternate-week SCIM slice in addition.

Thanks,
